snippet.title: Play Koi-Koi Online Free — Hanafuda Legends Full Tour
snippet.description:
🎴 Play free (no download): https://www.hanafudalegends.com
🇯🇵 Play free (no download): https://www.hanafudalegends.com/ja
Interactive tutorial: https://www.hanafudalegends.com/tutorial
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/Z47hFx3W
Follow us on X: https://x.com/Hanafuda_Legend

A full tour of Hanafuda Legends — the free browser-based Koi-Koi game. Ranked multiplayer, AI opponents from beginner to expert, private rooms to play with friends, 15 regional deck designs from across Japan, and full English/Japanese support. No download, no signup — just click and play. Over 2,000 players already active, with new game modes in development.

📖 How to play Koi-Koi: https://www.hanafudalegends.com/how-to-play
